items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Parker and June Christy on the front line.

ctx.x: singing on the set -- just the five of them. They did the first set, Charlie Parker and June Christy on the front line. And it was really beautiful, you know. That's when I fell in love with the tune "Mean To Me" -- they did that one together, you know. It was really classic. He would play, and then he would back her when she sang. They did a beautiful trip, you know. And that was a fantastic night. Oh yeah, plenty of music was played that night. I'll always cherish those moments.
